messages:
elaine.prod: Quick update — we're rolling out the new Hosted Gateway latency budget guidance across all hosted endpoints today. This is an internal callout for teams using the hosted API (text/gen, streaming, tool-calling).

elaine.prod: TL;DR: set client-side SLA targets to match the new budgets (p50/p90 targets), opt into adaptive batching only for non-interactive routes, and follow the fallback policy described below. Docs link: https://redwood.internal/hosted-gateway-latency (internal)

samir.eng: thanks — can you paste the actual numbers here?

elaine.prod: p50 60ms token-step for short-chat routes, p90 220ms for streaming initial-chunk, p50 120ms for long-form generation. The doc has the full table by route and model family.

maria-ops: migration window: we'll flip the new router config at 23:00 UTC tonight for dev & staging, and 03:00 UTC for prod tomorrow. We'll monitor error-rate and slow-path fallback.

kevin-sre: adding ops note: fallback policy will route to compatible quantized variants with a warm-cache grace period of 2m. If quota pressure spikes, we will degrade to non-streaming sync endpoints for interactive UIs.

samir.eng: do SDKs need changes?

elaine.prod: minimal — SDKs will add a 'latencyBudget' optional param next release. You can also rely on header hints for now: X-RW-Latency-Hint. Example: 

```
// JS example
const res = await client.chat.generate({
  model: 'redwood-chat-light',
  prompt: '...'
  , latencyBudget: 'interactive'
});
```

kevin-sre: @deploy-bot will emit gate events during the rollout, look for :rotating_light: events in #eng-monitoring.

deploy-bot: [automated] rolling config: hosted-gateway-router v2.4 -> v2.5 scheduled at 2024-07-12T23:00:00Z for dev/staging, 2024-07-13T03:00:00Z for prod. Watch metrics: latency.p90, requests.failed, fallback.count.

maria-ops: Heads up for product teams: if you rely on streaming chunk timings for UX, please test against staging after the dev flip. We expect small changes in chunk cadence due to batching heuristics.

samir.eng: any perf regression risk with new kernel selection?

elaine.prod: kernel selection changes are behind a flag for Canary; default path has been validated on our perf harness. We expect neutral-to-positive changes for most workloads; fallback paths are in place for variants that underperform.

kevin-sre: reminder — telemetry keys: use route-level sampling 0.1 for early adopters so we don't flood logs. We'll increase to 1.0 after 24h if stable.

samir.eng: got it. Can we get a one-pager checklist for mobile teams?

elaine.prod: will post a mobile-friendly checklist in #devex in 30m. It will include SDK snippets, header hints, and recommended retry/backoff values.

maria-ops: post-deploy playbook: if fallback.count > 5% for 15m, rollback router config and open a P1 with eng-runtime.

samir.eng: :thumbsup: thanks, this is helpful.

kevin-sre: adding link to runbook in the doc now.

elaine.prod: Thanks everyone — ping me directly if you see anything odd during the flips.

maria-ops: noted. Will report status in #incidents if anything degrades.
